summary: Repair the MC-SA-01 PostgreSQL migration foreign-key types and align the existing last-active-branch regression test with automatic company bootstrap.
unacceptedMigrationRepairReason: Fresh PostgreSQL execution failed before MC-SA-01 could be accepted as an executable migration because company_id and password-recovery user_id were declared TEXT while their referenced Platform Core keys are UUID. The repair changes only those two foreign-key column types. Full verification also exposed an existing Platform Core regression test that incorrectly created a second branch after createCompany had already bootstrapped the active main branch; the test is corrected to exercise the actual last-active-branch invariant without changing production behavior.
